preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 49 and len(s) % 2 == 1 and s.islower() for s in [stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))])
preconditions.description: Each string s in the test cases has an odd length between 1 and 49 inclusive and consists of lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all(len(c) == 1 and c.islower() for c in [stdin.splitlines()[2*i+2] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))])
preconditions.description: Each character c in the test cases is a single lowercase letter.

postconditions.description: The output consists of t lines, each containing either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'YES' if stdin.splitlines()[2*i+1].count(stdin.splitlines()[2*i+2]) % 2 == 1 else stdout.splitlines()[i] == 'NO') for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'YES' if the string s can be reduced to the letter c, otherwise 'NO'.
